verdict.rationale: BigQuery does not host a standard OpenAPI/swagger.json file (probe confirms openapi.json/swagger.json paths 404), but it exposes Google's own machine-readable API Discovery Document (bigquery:v2) at the REST reference which was verified to download keylessly and parse cleanly into resources/methods — functionally equivalent to an OpenAPI spec though in a different format. Missing for 10: a canonical OpenAPI/Swagger file, first-party statement equating the Discovery doc to OpenAPI, and independent community confirmation of AI-native tooling consuming it.
